title: Smooth projective completions of curve normalizations after inseparable extension
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field] and let $X$ be a separated finite type $k$-scheme [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with $\dim X\leq1$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. There are a finite purely inseparable field extension $k'/k$ [def-weil-pbc-finite-purely-inseparable-extension], a finite set $I$, finite separable extensions $k_i/k'$ [def-weil-pbc-separable-algebraic-extension], and a diagram over $k'$ $$\coprod_{i\in I}Y_i\xrightarrow{\nu}X_{k'},\qquad Y_i\xrightarrow{j_i}\overline Y_i\longrightarrow\operatorname{Spec}(k_i).$$ Here $X_{k'}=X\times_{\operatorname{Spec}k}\operatorname{Spec}k'$ [def-pc-fibre-product], and $\nu$ is the normalization: explicitly the disjoint union of the normalizations of the reduced irreducible components of $(X_{k'})_{\mathrm{red}}$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction] [def-weil-irreducible-components] [def-sc-normalization] [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family]. Each $j_i$ is an open immersion with dense nonempty image [def-weil-open-immersion]. Each $\overline Y_i$ is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], projective [def-kun-projective], and geometrically irreducible over $k_i$ [def-pc-geometrically-irreducible], with dimension at most one. All the schemes displayed are of finite presentation over $k'$. The set $I$ is empty precisely when $X$ is empty.
